cases.outcome: Feeds, Larder, Settings and episode detail use the same fixture metadata.
The AI Daily Brief Apple ID 1680633614 admits exactly 5, 10, or valid custom canonical metadata records and honors the Settings default.
Recognized Apple URL gives pending then success feedback, admits canonical rows to Feeds, and does no audio work.
Cancel, duplicate, and unsupported URL retain input and give named inline feedback.
Keep starts pending, then moves the canonical item to Larder; Skip moves it to Off the list.
Bulk Skip moves successful selections, retains the failed Tide selection, and retries only that selected item.
Episodes contains all lifecycle rows; Downloaded audio is a separate subset with an empty state only when it has no audio records, and only ready items expose Play.
Custom order stays explicit; Newest sorts dated rows first and leaves unknown dates last.
Restore returns one canonical skipped fixture to Feeds.
Missing episode page remains unavailable and never substitutes the feed URL.
